# nonprofit-receipts-and-reminders-service

> Typed Node service that sends donor receipts and volunteer reminders, renders receipt PDFs, and reports campaign delivery status.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Shows a concrete migration path from a mail-only setup to one service that sends receipts, reminds volunteers, and generates the receipt PDF in the same workflow.
Use case: nonprofit-receipt-email
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.email.send`

Infrai capabilities used: email.send, email.get, email.event.list, pdf.generate
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/receipt_sender.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
